reason: I would not take the membership, we would only go once or twice a month. But a $12 drop-in with a coffee included is easy to try once with the kids when I need somewhere indoors.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, not enough to justify a $59 membership. The drop-in only makes sense if it stays a casual thing.
would_change_my_mind: A flexible pass, like a 5 or 10 visit punch card that doesn't expire quickly, would get me to pay up front.
